subject: Educational Psychology
stem: According to Bandura, a student's belief in their own capability is strengthened most powerfully when they personally succeed at a genuinely challenging task themselves, rather than by watching someone else succeed or being verbally encouraged. This most influential source of self-efficacy is called:
explanation: Bandura identified four sources of self-efficacy: mastery experiences (one's own successes — the strongest source), vicarious experiences (watching a similar peer succeed), verbal persuasion (encouragement from others), and physiological states (interpreting anxiety/calm as a sign of readiness) — mastery experience has the greatest impact because it is direct, first-hand evidence of one's own competence.
